versions.content: If the XfrmDevErrorDetect switch is enabled and the configuration variant is VARIANT - POST - BUILD, the function E2EXf_Init shall check if a NULL pointer is passed for the ConfigPtr parameter. In case of an error the remaining function shall not be executed and the function E2EXf_Ini t shall report development error code E2EXF_E_PARAM_POINTER to the Det_ReportError service of the Default Error Tracer .
